rv.q: Frankly, I was blown away by how well this play works in the here and now, how relevant it feels.
It’s launched by this excellent, breathtaking and thought-provoking production of Sam Shepard’s American classic.
With this revival, Paramount wrote the next chapter.
I will tell you that you will laugh, you will think and you will love this production.
In my opinion, the show is well acted by Ball and Page and I like the realistic set, especially the toasters being able to cook toast, but the play itself feels emotionally one note.
That said, the work is now and has always been an absolute showcase for the lead actors and this production does not disappoint in that respect.

cn.t: Paramount's revival of Shepard's classic earns strong praise for superb acting and swift pacing that proves the 40-year-old sibling rivalry drama still resonates today, though some question if there's much new to say.
